newsitem.title: FRANCE: Michelin to cut 1,445 jobs in France.
newsitem.headline: Michelin to cut 1,445 jobs in France.

text.p: Tiremaker Michelin said Friday that it planned to eliminate 1,445 jobs through early retirements, transfers and other measures.
"The expected results should be obtained by recourse to voluntary measures," it said in a statement, adding that it hoped to avoid outright dismissals.
It said the job cuts, which would affect Michelin's French tire operations and distribution centres, reflected heightened competition in the European tire market.
Michelin said it would present the plan to staff March 6.
The plan entails 500 early retirements and 235 job cuts that would be accompanied by retraining programmes.
Internal transfers, flexible work schedules and further early retirements are expected to preserve 710 jobs, it said.
